caption: The drawing depicts a pitcher with a handle, featuring a combination of colors and decorative elements. The body of the pitcher is primarily light blue with vertical lines, and there is a beige diamond-patterned section around the base. The handle is also beige and appears textured, with horizontal stripes. The pitcher has a gray, scalloped-edged lid with a knob on top that is shaped with a swirl and leaf-like detail. Around the upper part of the pitcher, just below the lid, there is a pink ribbon tied into a bow. On the main body, below the ribbon, there is a decorative motif consisting of green leaves and pink flowers. The background is a plain, light tan color and is free from additional objects or patterns.
title: Pitcher
